 Listed at -156 on the moneyline, Elise Mertens looks to impose her superiority over Leylah Fernandez in the first round of the 2026 Ningbo Open.
 Current Form:
 After reaching the semifinals of the 2026 China Open, Elise Mertens crashed out in the first round of the 2026 Wuhan Open at the hands of Daria Snigur, 4-6, 5-7. Mertens is 5-3 in the Asian swing of the 2026 WTA Tour season.
 Leylah Fernandez has gone 7-3 in the Asian swing of the WTA Tour. Fernandez won the 2026 Singapore Open, bombed out in the second round of the 2026 China Open, and reached the round of 16 at the 2026 Wuhan Open.
 The Matchup: Mertens holds a 2-1 series lead over Fernandez. In their last meeting at the 2025 Dubai Open, Mertens swept Fernandez 6-2, 6-2.

 Our Elise Mertens vs Leylah Fernandez Prediction
 The Difference Maker: When she’s close to her top level, Mertens presents a difficult matchup even for the lefty Fernandez because she can absorb and redirect Fernandez’s cross-court shots. In their last meeting in Dubai, Mertens dominated Fernandez by holding all her service games and breaking Canadian 4 times.
 What to Expect: Mertens guts out a close win over Fernandez. The Belgian’s shocking loss to Snigur happened because Mertens was unprepared for the Ukrainian’s unorthodox playing style. Against Fernandez, she already has the blueprint and game plan to attack her weaknesses and counter her strengths.
